root_cause.explanation: Both V57 checkpoints emit finite label-1 tensors with scores above 0.001, but every decoded box is degenerate after clipping. The frozen COCO adapter excludes zero-width or zero-height boxes, which explains the historical zero detection count. V55 uses the same score, postprocess, and evaluator paths and produces 5,535,000 valid decoded boxes.
root_cause.secondary_factor: The torchvision FCOS regression head applies ReLU to bbox distances. Both V57 bbox-regression bias vectors are non-positive, while all four V55 bbox-regression biases are positive; the observed all-row geometry confirms collapse in both V57 checkpoints.
